title: HoReCa
description: Hotels, restaurants, laundries and other hospitality venues use ozonation to create a comfortable environment, eliminate odors and maintain high hygiene standards.

secondhand.title: Secondhand stores
secondhand.heroDesc: Removal of characteristic clothing odor. Customer comfort and higher sales.
secondhand.content:
The characteristic odor of clothing in secondhand stores comes from mandatory disinfection. Before sale, items are treated with formaldehyde or methyl bromide gas to kill viruses and bacteria. The disinfectants dissipate by the time clothes reach the shelves, but the characteristic smell remains.

This odor is the main retail problem in secondhand. It fills the whole store and triggers unpleasant associations with worn clothing. Some customers spend less time in the store because of discomfort.

Odor affects perceived product quality. Customers subconsciously pay less for items with an unpleasant smell, even if they are in excellent condition.

Regular clothing ozonation effectively removes the odor and freshens the store air. Ozonation is done during off-hours for 1–3 hours. The gas penetrates all crevices and corners, treating all merchandise.
benefits: Treatment of all merchandise at once
advantages: Higher product appeal — items perceived as better quality
Destruction of dust mites — important for allergy sufferers
Mold removal — relevant for basement premises

businessProblem.title: Business problem:
businessProblem.text: Odor affects perceived product quality. Customers subconsciously pay less for items with an unpleasant smell, even if they are in excellent condition.

items.title: Complete odor removal
items.description: Ozone neutralizes disinfectant molecules rather than masking them. Result — fresh air.

items.title: Treatment without unloading
items.description: All merchandise is treated simultaneously, no need to remove items from hangers.

items.title: Additional disinfection
items.description: Ozone destroys bacteria, viruses and dust mites — additional quality guarantee.

items.title: Customer comfort
items.description: Pleasant atmosphere in store = more time to choose = more purchases.

steps.title: Room preparation
steps.description: Store closes. Windows and doors closed. Supply ventilation turned off for maximum ozone concentration.

steps.title: Ozonator placement
steps.description: Wall-mounted ozonator placed 40-60 cm from ceiling. Mobile — at maximum height.

steps.title: Ozonation
steps.description: Treatment mode activated for 1-3 hours depending on room volume.

steps.title: Ventilation or waiting
steps.description: For night treatment, ventilation is not needed — ozone dissipates on its own in 2-3 hours. By store opening, only a light freshness smell remains.

calculation.title: Equipment calculation
calculation.text: Ozonator capacity is selected at: 1 g/hour per 25 m³ of room volume.

workMode.title: Operating mode
items: Automatic start on timer after store closing
By morning ozone completely dissipates, freshness remains
No staff involvement required — full automation
For strong odor — first 3-5 days treatment for 2-3 hours

highlight.title: Protective equipment:
highlight.text: If staff is in the room during ozonation (e.g., to turn on the unit), a respirator or gas mask with charcoal filter is required.

payback.title: Payback:
payback.text: With savings of 10 thousand ₽/month on air fresheners, the ozonator pays for itself in 2-3 months. Further operation — only electricity cost.

items: Higher product appeal — items perceived as better quality
